name: Bunny Storage
line: Store and replicate files across regions with an S3-compatible API.

free.text: 14-day trial; no fixed storage quota published

cells.regions: Standard and Edge regions; up to 9 Standard regions

files.math: 100 GB at $0.01 per GB a month. The $1 account minimum applies. API requests and outbound data (egress) are free.
